_notice: SYNTHETIC ROLE-PLAY TEST DATA: Simulated meeting dialogues for testing Meeting-to-Scope pipeline.

transcripts.content:
Alex: Hi Sarah, thanks for joining today. To start off, what is your primary objective for this directory platform?
Sarah: Hi Alex. Our goal is to launch the Apex Legal Directory, connecting certified attorneys with prospective corporate clients across North America.
Alex: Excellent. What key features are you looking to provide for your attorneys?
Sarah: First, we need payment processing with Stripe so attorneys can subscribe. We want recurring monthly billing for our three membership tiers.
Alex: Brilliant Directories handles Stripe payment gateways and recurring subscriptions out of the box.
Sarah: That's great. We also need location search so clients can search attorneys by city and adjust the search radius between 25 and 50 miles.
Alex: Perfect, location radius search is native. What about custom integrations?
Sarah: We use HubSpot CRM. We want any attorney who registers to automatically sync their contact details and tier to HubSpot via custom CRM integration.
Alex: Understood. That will require custom API integration. What about verified badges?
Sarah: Yes, verified badges on profile cards so verified bar members stand out.
Alex: Got it. We will draft the initial scope.

Alex: Hi Marcus, thanks for the technical follow-up. We wanted to clarify the HubSpot integration and security requirements.
Marcus: Hi Alex. For HubSpot, we only need one-way member sync: when an attorney signs up, push their name, email, phone, and bar state to HubSpot. No two-way sync needed.
Alex: That simplifies the integration scope significantly. What about email templates and spam security?
Marcus: Yes, we need to customize the automated welcome email with our corporate branding and legal disclosures. Also, our forms must have reCAPTCHA bot spam prevention enabled.
Alex: Both email template customization and Google reCAPTCHA v3 are natively supported in Brilliant Directories settings.
Marcus: Great, so no custom coding needed for those two.

Sarah: Hi Alex, our board met yesterday and we have a couple of scope adjustments.
Alex: Sure Sarah, what needs to be changed?
Sarah: First, we are removing the custom CRM integration for phase 1. We decided to export member data to CSV once a month manually instead of spending budget on the HubSpot API bridge.
Alex: Understood, so we drop the custom CRM integration. And data export to CSV is already a native Brilliant Directories feature.
Sarah: Exactly. Second, we want to add a new requirement: claimable business listings. We want pre-imported law firms to be able to claim their listing with email verification.
Alex: That's a great feature. Brilliant Directories provides Claimable Business Listings natively. Anything else?
Sarah: No, that is it. Please send us the updated Statement of Work.
